scope: Static continuation after the private isolation derivative; no checker, staging, builder, installer, service, or product execution.

trace.observation: fixture_repo returns the initial commit as stale_base; the stale control adds a commit and uses stale_base for recorded upstream_base and gated_tip, but the main stale control does not advance refs/heads/origin/main to stale_head.
source tuple roots, ownership, cleanliness, HEAD and tl/integration tree are checked before D68 is called.
gate tuple objects and refs are checked, then source and gate roots are compared.
caller creates a unique receipt/stage child but passes the outer service_tmp to run_delivery; run_delivery owns the retained fixed trace path.
D68 resolves recorded upstream_base and current origin/main; for non-App repositories it refuses only when they differ.
CandidateError is recorded as a FAIL receipt and exits nonzero; the caller receives that integer from run_delivery.
caller writes a final receipt with status FAIL for a nonzero D68 result and returns the code; invoke discards the integer and only reports Python OSError/ValueError exceptions.

prior_positive_and_same33.prior_positive: Preserved prior actual caller -> delivery lifecycle -> D68 -> bounded stub PASS; its log shows D68 PASS and the positive receipt. It is retained evidence, not rerun.
prior_positive_and_same33.same33: The preserved same33 route also enters candidate.main, run_wrapper, delivery_lifecycle and the real D68 wrapper with a per-case TMPDIR. Its lifecycle/floor/trace cases prove lifecycle safety only; they do not qualify the seven source-guard negatives.
prior_positive_and_same33.shared_route: Both routes use the real caller and D68 path. The earlier collision came from the checker reusing one outer service_tmp; same33 avoids it by giving each case a distinct case directory.

false_positive_rules: A refusal caused by the disk floor, retained trace, malformed sampler, source identity, or caller service-TMP validation is not a semantic PASS for a later D68/source branch.
The prior stale-nonapp trace collision was lifecycle refusal before D68 source_snapshot and was not a semantic PASS.
The current stale-nonapp fixture accepts because upstream_base equals origin/main; its PASS receipt is a false-positive control result and is not a semantic PASS.
